status: PORTED on 13 Nov 2026 with these settings unchanged: pan_tompkins.py and BeatDetector.kt run tp3, tp2_config.json is version tp3, and analysis/tp3_port_check.txt shows the shipped streaming detector gives the positions tp3_candidate.retime() gave. This file and tp3_candidate.py remain as the record of what was evaluated and as the offline reference; do not change them.
what: Polarity-free beat position: the lag (within +-LAG samples of the 5-15 Hz peak) at which the beat's window correlates best with the median beat, parabolic interpolation of the correlation, referred to one followed peak of the median beat. Flagged when the correlation is under R_MIN, the best lag is at the end of the range, the window holds a gap, the median beat is not ready, or the followed peak had to be picked again. Window and template depth are tp2.1's (R_BEFORE_S, R_AFTER_S, POL_KEEP, POL_MIN).
tuned_on: All 48 MIT-BIH Arrhythmia records, which are development data from 13 Nov 2026 (the 36 formerly held-out ones were spent on tp2.1 and on the alg1 arithmetic check), plus our recordings dual03, tb01 and tb02 and the BIDMC ECGs (coverage only). analysis/tp3_mitdb48_dev_grid.txt, tp3_mitdb48_dev.txt, tp3_own_recordings.txt, tp3_bidmc_coverage.txt.
selection: Form: aligned template with a followed-peak reference. The unaligned forms mistimed beats on tb02 (zero-phase SDNN 67 ms against 53-54 ms from every other form and from tp2.1); the anchor reference lets absolute beat times wander (sd against annotations 3.5 ms against 1.1 ms). LAG is tp2.1's CORR_LAG. R_MIN is the value with the lowest mean absolute RMSSD error on the 44 non-paced records under the causal filter. TRACK was set by hand.

heldout_protocol.data: St Petersburg INCART 12-lead Arrhythmia Database (PhysioNet, ODC-By 1.0, checked 13 Nov 2026): 75 half-hour records from 32 patients, downloaded 13 Nov 2026 and not opened before this file was committed.
heldout_protocol.front_end: lead II, 257 -> 256 Hz, 0.5-40 Hz with a 50 Hz notch, causal and zero-phase; tp2.1 detection as frozen
heldout_protocol.metrics: per record and per patient, tp2.1 against tp3 on the same beats: coverage, RMSSD error against annotations, pipeline NN coverage, sd against annotations, EC57 Se and P+
heldout_protocol.caveat: INCART annotations sit 'in the middle of the QRS complex' and their positions were not corrected by hand, so its annotation RMSSD carries that jitter. The before/after comparison stands; the absolute errors do not mean what they mean on MIT-BIH.
heldout_protocol.rule: run once; nothing in this file is changed in response
